basis: Observed # Subtest records in retained TAP, not inferred from argv order.

cases.name: stimulus: peak is exactly 1, segments are ordered, inside the buffer, edges faded
A-weighting matches IEC 61672 reference gains
clean pass-through: no findings, gain/delay recovered
harmonic distortion is measured (cubic nonlinearity) and chain floor is subtracted
noise floor, SNR and DC are measured
frequency response roll-off, crosstalk, polarity, dropout and clock offset
regression: opposite stereo response errors cannot cancel into a clean flatness result
bad captures give an issue, never a crash
thresholds and spec notes
unavailable audio measurements never describe incomplete checks as all passed
non-finite samples and malformed capture formats cannot become numerical evidence
safePlayLevel never exceeds -12 dBFS and maps non-numeric input to the -12 dBFS default
the exported test signal (WAV) peaks at -12 dBFS, never full scale, and its meta matches the file
a recording made elsewhere may start several seconds early when maxLagSec allows it
clipping is counted in every driven segment: an input that overloads only on the -12 dBFS step is REVIEW, not a device FAIL
setup and measuring keep the safety copy visible; the level field never goes above -12 dBFS
keyboard shortcuts start from the panel, preserve form controls, and Escape cancels only this run
progress reserves the final stage until analysis completes and disappears with results

stereo response plots expose opposite channel errors instead of displaying a flat average
